UnitAbilities.Title: Purgatus Quarry
UnitAbilities.Text:
At the start of the first battle round, select up to one enemy unit to be this unit’s hunted:


- This unit’s attacks that target this unit’s hunted unit can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
- Each time this unit’s hunted is destroyed, select up to one enemy unit to be this unit’s hunted.

Rule.Title: Codex Discipline
Rule.Text: You can select one Combat Doctrine one additional time per battle.

Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army). When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's melee attacks have +1A until the end of the phase.

Rule.Title: Mission Tactics
Rule.Text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

RESTRICTIONS: Your army can include ADEPTUS ASTARTES DEATHWATCH units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

With the exception of Kill Team Cassius (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium), your army cannot include any AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEATHWATCH units.

Enhancements.Name: Osseus Key
Enhancements.Description: WATCH MASTER/TECHMARINE model only. While an enemy VEHICLE unit is within 6” of this model, that enemy unit’s attacks have -1 A.

Enhancements.Name: The Tome of Ectoclades
Enhancements.Description: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, the assault doctrine, devastator doctrine and tactical doctrine are active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
